UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Stores a player's Prism Pour progression, coin balance, settings, and 24-hour daily reward claim timestamp.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

currentLevel.description: Currently selected or active puzzle level (1-10000).

dailyRewardCount.description: Total number of 24-hour daily rewards claimed.

lastDailyRewardAt.description: Server timestamp of the last daily coin reward claim, or null before first claim.

muted.description: Whether Web Audio sound effects are muted.

colorblindMode.description: Whether geometric colorblind symbols are rendered on liquid layers.

bestMovesByLevel.description: Map from string level number to lowest recorded moves.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

ActiveGameSession.title: ActiveGameSession
ActiveGameSession.description: Stores an in-progress puzzle board state so players can resume mid-level across devices.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

level.description: Level number for this active session.

parMoves.description: Solver par target moves for the level.

extraBottlesAdded.description: Number of extra bottles added in this level (0-2).

bottles.description: Current bottle stack state encoded as array of { layers: ColorId[] } objects.

initialBottles.description: Starting bottle stack state for level restart.

history.description: Ordered move history for undo support.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session state was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user game progress, coin wallet, preferences, and 24-hour daily reward state.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Active mid-level puzzle board session for cross-device resume.
